### Problem & Motivation
A clear and concise description of the user problem or limitation. Explain why existing workflows or deterministic scoring rules do not address this need.

### Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Describe any changes to API routers, UI screens, LLM prompts, or deterministic ATS scoring rules.

### SYSTEM.md & Deprecation Ledger (§13) Evaluation
- Which sections of `docs/SYSTEM.md` will this feature modify or extend?
- Does this feature supersede an existing code path or design without immediately deleting it? 
  - [ ] Yes (If yes, define the **removal trigger** that must be recorded in `docs/SYSTEM.md` §13)
  - [ ] No (Pure additive feature or complete drop-in replacement)
